metadata.description: The Asgardr operations org — an evidence-led skill organization for a ten-computer, local-first intelligence fabric. Eight departments install independently; two are reviewer-class.

plugins.name: operator
plugins.description: Office of the Operator — authority tiers, single-operator continuity, and the decision ledger. What may run autonomously, what stays quarantined, and what only the operator decides.

plugins.name: evidence
plugins.description: Evidence Review (reviewer-class) — green is not evidence; the artifact is. Verification of claims, negative controls, test forensics, and restore drills. Blocking findings are not overrulable by the department under review.

plugins.name: publication-safety
plugins.description: Publication Safety (reviewer-class) — the synthetic-only public boundary. Pre-publish review, synthetic fixtures, secret hygiene, and redirect integrity for every public Asgardr surface. Blocking findings are not overrulable by the department under review.

plugins.name: fabric
plugins.description: Fabric — the five-node k3s core. Node lifecycle with proven redundancy, pinned releases with named rollback targets, and staged upgrade runbooks.

plugins.name: mesh
plugins.description: Mesh — the five mesh peers. Peer lifecycle, credential rotation proven by the old key failing, and reachability audits from artifacts rather than dashboards.

plugins.name: retrieval
plugins.description: Retrieval — the knowledge fabric. Corpus hygiene, grounded answering that refuses cleanly on silence, scoped retrieval as the privacy boundary, and replica consistency.

plugins.name: workloads
plugins.description: Workloads — the built public works. Shipping self-contained pages, canary progression with deferred capabilities, and device-fit acceptance on real phones.

plugins.name: records
plugins.description: Records — the civic-notebook doctrine. Claim labeling (confirmed / preliminary / unknown), discrepancy ledgers that flag contradictions instead of resolving them silently, and sourced-and-dated citations.
